claims.statement: Analyze the current official website's accessibility, usability, and user experience.
claims.metric: baseline completion, duration, steps, errors, and usability measures
claims.artifact: research_task_attempts and research_responses under the frozen protocol
claims.rule: Report baseline estimates and uncertainty; do not imply improvement.

claims.statement: Identify common search, findability, navigation, and interaction problems.
claims.metric: task failure/error taxonomy plus coded open feedback
claims.artifact: baseline task attempts, observations, and coded feedback export
claims.rule: Report prevalence, denominator, and coding limits.

claims.statement: Determine appropriate AI applications for the university website.
claims.metric: retrieval, answer, safety, usability, accessibility, latency, and cost scorecard
claims.artifact: versioned AI evaluation report and design rationale
claims.rule: Call an application appropriate only against frozen requirements and measured tradeoffs.

claims.statement: Develop intelligent retrieval, chatbot assistance, smart navigation, and student support.
claims.metric: required production journeys and release gates passed
claims.artifact: deployed build, schema, tests, live checks, accessibility evidence
claims.rule: Feature deployment proves implementation only, not user benefit.

claims.statement: Evaluate satisfaction, information-access speed, and administrative workload.
claims.metric: paired user outcomes and comparable aggregate workload windows
claims.artifact: locked anonymous study/workload export and reproducible report
claims.rule: Claim direction only from measured effect and uncertainty.

claims.statement: Responses are based on verified university information rather than unsupported model prediction.
claims.metric: correctness, citation precision/completeness, unsupported-claim rate, stale/private leakage
claims.artifact: gold evaluation run with claim-to-chunk citations
claims.rule: Pass only at frozen #104 gates; otherwise report misses.

claims.statement: The system returns accurate and context-aware responses.
claims.metric: reviewer correctness/relevance by language/domain and safe abstention
claims.rule: No broad accuracy claim from demonstrations or static fixtures.

claims.statement: The platform supports campus office and facility navigation.
claims.metric: verified place coverage, route correctness, accessible text-route completion
claims.artifact: source-owned campus graph, walkthrough record, accessibility review
claims.owner: campus data owner and research team
claims.rule: Do not claim turn-by-turn correctness without physical validation.

claims.statement: Users find information faster and with less effort.
claims.metric: paired duration, steps, errors, completion, and SEQ
claims.rule: Achieved only if effect, confidence interval, missingness, and limitations are reported.

claims.statement: The platform improves perceived usefulness, ease of use, accessibility, and satisfaction.
claims.metric: frozen SUS/SEQ/custom construct scores plus accessibility evidence
claims.artifact: approved questionnaire analysis and WCAG/manual review
claims.rule: Do not substitute four informal statements or automated checks for this evidence.

claims.statement: The platform reduces repetitive inquiries and administrative handling burden.
claims.metric: comparable inquiry counts, duplicates, handling time, escalation, and confirmed resolution
claims.rule: Never count an answer as deflection without explicit confirmed resolution.

claims.statement: Faculty spend less time on routine schedule or requirement questions.
claims.metric: faculty inquiry frequency and handling time under an approved measurement window
claims.rule: Remain expected unless directly measured; do not infer from administrative data.

claims.statement: The university's digital service quality improves.
claims.metric: predefined composite or separately reported task, usability, accessibility, reliability, and satisfaction measures
claims.artifact: final research report with versioned component evidence
claims.rule: No unweighted overall claim without a frozen definition.

claims.statement: The public research system is informational and does not modify official records or replace decisions.
claims.metric: successful unauthorized public mutations and decision/action capabilities
claims.rule: Required result is zero public mutations and no decision automation.

claims.statement: The work provides a reusable foundation for future research.
claims.metric: reproducible schema, protocol, codebook, version metadata, and anonymized evidence package
claims.rule: Claim the available artifacts specifically; do not claim external reuse without evidence.
